headline: METI requests additional investment from Fiscal Investment and Loan Program and tax incentives for Rapidus, aiming for mass production
summary: METI's fiscal 2027 budget request includes 150 billion yen from the Fiscal Investment and Loan Program for Rapidus, which targets mass production of advanced semiconductors in the second half of next year. Tax incentives are also requested.
why: Rapidus is a Japanese chipmaker backed by government support, aiming to produce advanced logic chips domestically. Government funding shapes the timeline and viability of Japan's semiconductor strategy.
